manifest:
version: 1
name: nextcloud
description: Files, calendars and contacts

sources:
  stable:
    path: nextcloud
    description: Nextcloud with PostgreSQL
  testing:
    path: nextcloud-testing
    description: The next major release

secrets:
  nextcloud-admin-password:
    description: Password of the admin account
  nextcloud-db-password:
    description: Password of the database user
    generate: true
  smtp-password:
    description: Password of your mail server
